title: Signal: A declared name is one edit away from `mime`
scope: A mix.lock file that declares a locked package name in mix.lock within one edit of `mime`.
limitations: It compares declared names with `mime` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `mime` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: An organisation that deliberately publishes its own package under a name one edit away from a popular one is reported too, because the rule compares the declared text, not publisher identity or download history.
